text.en: Many pet owners praise groomers like Stuart and Chelsea for their welcoming attitude, patience, and professional styling over many years. Longtime customers express great loyalty to the parlour. However, two recent reviewers report rude interactions and tense communication when discussing grooming requirements and matting.

Most clients are delighted with the haircuts, noting that their dogs look adorable and well groomed after scissor trims and nail clipping. Conversely, two customers were unhappy with the outcome, with one reporting severe matting left behind the ears and another complaining that their dog was fully shaved down without agreement.

Several owners emphasize that their nervous or difficult dogs are treated with great affection, coming out of the salon happy and wagging their tails. In contrast, two reviewers were distressed, describing rough handling that left a puppy fearful of being touched or an unexpectedly shaved dog acting subdued after returning home.

q.en: What grooming treatments are offered at Groom Dog City?

a.en: Clients report receiving full haircuts, breed scissor styling, warm baths, and nail clipping for dramatic or nervous dogs.

q.en: Can the groomers handle nervous or difficult dogs?

a.en: Several owners note that staff handle anxious pets gently, although one reviewer raised concerns regarding rough handling.

q.en: How does the salon address matted coats?

a.en: Groomers may recommend shaving severely matted coats, though reviewers advise agreeing on styling choices before the appointment.
